result.reason: The clause does not reach the preferred position because the fixed-dollar limb is left blank rather than set at USD 1,000,000, and it does not add a mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages. The unchanged definition of “Fees” as only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee also means that referring to Fees under all Order Forms does not cure the fee-base issue. The blank cap prevents the language from cleanly reaching the fallback position as well. The existing mutuality, carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment are preserved, but the incomplete placeholder and ineffective fee-base revision are not professionally complete or minimally effective drafting.
